   19 #===============================================================================
   20 # User switches out. If user is a wild Pokémon, ends the battle instead.
   21 # (Teleport (Gen 8+))
   22 #===============================================================================
   23 class Battle::Move::SwitchOutUserStatusMove < Battle::Move
   24   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
   25     if user.wild?
   26       if !@battle.pbCanRun?(user.index) || user.allAllies.length > 0
   27         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
   28         return true
   29       end
   30     elsif !@battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(user.index)
   31       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
   32       return true
   33     end
   34     return false
   35   end
   36 
   37   def pbEndOfMoveUsageEffect(user, targets, numHits, switchedBattlers)
   38     return if user.wild?
   39     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} went back to {2}!", user.pbThis,
   40                             @battle.pbGetOwnerName(user.index)))
   41     @battle.pbPursuit(user.index)
   42     return if user.fainted?
   43     newPkmn = @battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(user.index)   # Owner chooses
   44     return if newPkmn < 0
   45     @battle.pbRecallAndReplace(user.index, newPkmn)
   46     @battle.pbClearChoice(user.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
   47     @battle.moldBreaker = false
   48     @battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(user.index)
   49     switchedBattlers.push(user.index)
   50   end
   51 
   52   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
   53     if user.wild?
   54       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} fled from battle!", user.pbThis))
   55       @battle.decision = 3   # Escaped
   56     end
   57   end
   58 end

   62 # (Flip Turn, U-turn, Volt Switch)
   63 #===============================================================================
   64 class Battle::Move::SwitchOutUserDamagingMove < Battle::Move
   65   def pbEndOfMoveUsageEffect(user, targets, numHits, switchedBattlers)
   66     return if user.fainted? || numHits == 0 || @battle.pbAllFainted?(user.idxOpposingSide)
   67     targetSwitched = true
   68     targets.each do |b|
   69       targetSwitched = false if !switchedBattlers.include?(b.index)

   72     return if !@battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(user.index)
   73     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} went back to {2}!", user.pbThis,

   77     newPkmn = @battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(user.index)   # Owner chooses

   79     @battle.pbRecallAndReplace(user.index, newPkmn)
   80     @battle.pbClearChoice(user.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round

   87 #===============================================================================
   88 # Decreases the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage each. Then, user
   89 # switches out. Ignores trapping moves. (Parting Shot)
   90 #===============================================================================
   91 class Battle::Move::LowerTargetAtkSpAtk1SwitchOutUser < Battle::Move::TargetMultiStatDownMove
   92   def initialize(battle, move)
   93     super
   94     @statDown = [:ATTACK, 1, :SPECIAL_ATTACK, 1]
   95   end
   96 
   97   def pbEndOfMoveUsageEffect(user, targets, numHits, switchedBattlers)
   98     switcher = user
   99     targets.each do |b|
  100       next if switchedBattlers.include?(b.index)
  101       switcher = b if b.effects[PBEffects::MagicCoat] || b.effects[PBEffects::MagicBounce]
  102     end
  103     return if switcher.fainted? || numHits == 0
  104     return if !@battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(switcher.index)
  105     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} went back to {2}!", switcher.pbThis,
  106                             @battle.pbGetOwnerName(switcher.index)))
  107     @battle.pbPursuit(switcher.index)
  108     return if switcher.fainted?
  109     newPkmn = @battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(switcher.index)   # Owner chooses
  110     return if newPkmn < 0
  111     @battle.pbRecallAndReplace(switcher.index, newPkmn)
  112     @battle.pbClearChoice(switcher.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
  113     @battle.moldBreaker = false if switcher.index == user.index
  114     @battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(switcher.index)
  115     switchedBattlers.push(switcher.index)
  116   end
  117 end

  147 #===============================================================================
  148 # When used against a sole wild Pokémon, makes target flee and ends the battle;
  149 # fails if target is a higher level than the user.
  150 # When used against a trainer's Pokémon, target switches out.
  151 # For status moves. (Roar, Whirlwind)
  152 #===============================================================================
  153 class Battle::Move::SwitchOutTargetStatusMove < Battle::Move
  154   def ignoresSubstitute?(user); return true; end
  155   def canMagicCoat?;            return true; end
  156 
  157   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  158     if target.hasActiveAbility?(:SUCTIONCUPS) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  159       if show_message
  160         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
  161         if Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  162           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchors itself!", target.pbThis))
  163         else
  164           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchors itself with {2}!", target.pbThis, target.abilityName))
  165         end
  166         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  167       end
  168       return true
  169     end
  170     if target.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
  171       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} anchored itself with its roots!", target.pbThis)) if show_message
  172       return true
  173     end
  174     if target.wild? && target.allAllies.length == 0 && @battle.canRun
  175       # End the battle
  176       if target.level > user.level
  177         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  178         return true
  179       end
  180     elsif !target.wild?
  181       # Switch target out
  182       canSwitch = false
  183       @battle.eachInTeamFromBattlerIndex(target.index) do |_pkmn, i|
  184         canSwitch = @battle.pbCanSwitchIn?(target.index, i)
  185         break if canSwitch
  186       end
  187       if !canSwitch
  188         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  189         return true
  190       end
  191     else
  192       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  193       return true
  194     end
  195     return false
  196   end
  197 
  198   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  199     @battle.decision = 3 if target.wild?   # Escaped from battle
  200   end
  201 
  202   def pbSwitchOutTargetEffect(user, targets, numHits, switched_battlers)
  203     return if !switched_battlers.empty?
  204     return if user.fainted? || numHits == 0
  205     targets.each do |b|
  206       next if b.fainted? || b.damageState.unaffected
  207       next if b.wild?
  208       next if b.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain]
  209       next if b.hasActiveAbility?(:SUCTIONCUPS) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  210       newPkmn = @battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(b.index, true)   # Random
  211       next if newPkmn < 0
  212       @battle.pbRecallAndReplace(b.index, newPkmn, true)
  213       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} was dragged out!", b.pbThis))
  214       @battle.pbClearChoice(b.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
  215       @battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(b.index)
  216       switched_battlers.push(b.index)
  217       break
  218     end
  219   end
  220 end

  257 #===============================================================================
  258 # Trapping move. Traps for 5 or 6 rounds. Trapped Pokémon lose 1/16 of max HP
  259 # at end of each round.
  260 #===============================================================================
  261 class Battle::Move::BindTarget < Battle::Move
  262   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  263     return if target.fainted? || target.damageState.substitute
  264     return if target.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] > 0
  265     # Set trapping effect duration and info
  266     if user.hasActiveItem?(:GRIPCLAW)
  267       target.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 5) ? 8 : 6
  268     else
  269       target.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] = 5 + @battle.pbRandom(2)
  270     end
  271     target.effects[PBEffects::TrappingMove] = @id
  272     target.effects[PBEffects::TrappingUser] = user.index
  273     # Message
  274     msg = _INTL("{1} was trapped in the vortex!", target.pbThis)
  275     case @id
  276     when :BIND
  277       msg = _INTL("{1} was squeezed by {2}!", target.pbThis, user.pbThis(true))
  278     when :CLAMP
  279       msg = _INTL("{1} clamped {2}!", user.pbThis, target.pbThis(true))
  280     when :FIRESPIN
  281       msg = _INTL("{1} was trapped in the fiery vortex!", target.pbThis)
  282     when :INFESTATION
  283       msg = _INTL("{1} has been afflicted with an infestation by {2}!", target.pbThis, user.pbThis(true))
  284     when :MAGMASTORM
  285       msg = _INTL("{1} became trapped by Magma Storm!", target.pbThis)
  286     when :SANDTOMB
  287       msg = _INTL("{1} became trapped by Sand Tomb!", target.pbThis)
  288     when :WHIRLPOOL
  289       msg = _INTL("{1} became trapped in the vortex!", target.pbThis)
  290     when :WRAP
  291       msg = _INTL("{1} was wrapped by {2}!", target.pbThis, user.pbThis(true))
  292     end
  293     @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
  294   end
  295 end

  466 #===============================================================================
  467 # Power is doubled if a user's ally has already used this move this round. (Round)
  468 # If an ally is about to use the same move, make it go next, ignoring priority.
  469 #===============================================================================
  470 class Battle::Move::UsedAfterAllyRoundWithDoublePower < Battle::Move
  471   def pbBaseDamage(baseDmg, user, target)
  472     baseDmg *= 2 if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Round]
  473     return baseDmg

  476   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  477     user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Round] = true
  478     user.allAllies.each do |b|
  479       next if @battle.choices[b.index][0] != :UseMove || b.movedThisRound?
  480       next if @battle.choices[b.index][2].function_code != @function_code
  481       b.effects[PBEffects::MoveNext] = true
  482       b.effects[PBEffects::Quash]    = 0
  483       break
  484     end
  485   end

  488 #===============================================================================
  489 # Target moves immediately after the user, ignoring priority/speed. (After You)
  490 #===============================================================================
  491 class Battle::Move::TargetActsNext < Battle::Move
  492   def ignoresSubstitute?(user); return true; end
  493 
  494   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  495     # Target has already moved this round
  496     return true if pbMoveFailedTargetAlreadyMoved?(target, show_message)
  497     # Target was going to move next anyway (somehow)
  498     if target.effects[PBEffects::MoveNext]
  499       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  500       return true
  501     end
  502     # Target didn't choose to use a move this round
  503     oppMove = @battle.choices[target.index][2]
  504     if !oppMove
  505       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  506       return true
  507     end
  508     return false
  509   end

  511   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  512     target.effects[PBEffects::MoveNext] = true
  513     target.effects[PBEffects::Quash]    = 0
  514     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} took the kind offer!", target.pbThis))

  518 #===============================================================================
  519 # Target moves last this round, ignoring priority/speed. (Quash)
  520 #===============================================================================
  521 class Battle::Move::TargetActsLast < Battle::Move
  522   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  523     return true if pbMoveFailedTargetAlreadyMoved?(target, show_message)
  524     # Target isn't going to use a move
  525     oppMove = @battle.choices[target.index][2]
  526     if !oppMove
  527       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  528       return true
  529     end
  530     # Target is already maximally Quashed and will move last anyway
  531     highestQuash = 0
  532     @battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
  533       next if b.effects[PBEffects::Quash] <= highestQuash
  534       highestQuash = b.effects[PBEffects::Quash]
  535     end
  536     if highestQuash > 0 && target.effects[PBEffects::Quash] == highestQuash
  537       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  538       return true
  539     end
  540     # Target was already going to move last
  541     if highestQuash == 0 && @battle.pbPriority.last.index == target.index
  542       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  543       return true
  544     end
  545     return false
  546   end
